name: Home Fitness Equipment
description: Size the market for connected home fitness equipment.
formula: TAM = Population x Penetration_rate x Purchase_frequency x Average_spend
solution_logic: Step 1: Identify addressable population = target_population x addressable_segment
Step 2: Apply penetration rate = addressable_population x penetration_rate
Step 3: Calculate annual spend per user = purchase_frequency x avg_spend_per_purchase
Step 4: Calculate TAM = penetrating_users x annual_spend_per_user
key_insight: Market sizing is about defensible assumptions, not precision. Show your logic clearly -- the interviewer is testing your structure, not your arithmetic.
common_mistakes: Sizing the total population instead of the addressable segment
Forgetting purchase frequency -- confusing annual vs per-transaction spend
Not sanity-checking the output against known benchmarks
framework_soundbite: Top-down or bottom-up -- pick one, state your assumptions, and sanity-check the output. The logic matters more than the number.
business_contexts: a connected fitness hardware startup evaluating market entry
a private equity firm sizing demand for home fitness equipment
question_patterns: A connected fitness hardware startup is deciding whether to enter the home equipment market and wants to size the annual opportunity.

prompts.beginner: Estimate the total addressable market for connected home fitness equipment.
prompts.intermediate: A connected fitness hardware startup is deciding whether to enter the home equipment market and wants to size the annual opportunity.
prompts.advanced: A private equity firm is evaluating a home fitness equipment brand whose growth thesis depends on post-pandemic demand persisting at levels the firm's consumer analysts are skeptical of. Build an independent market size view before the bid deadline.
